subject: Renewal: multi-region Dedicated pools + EU/APAC expansion

Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + EU/APAC Dedicated expansion

Hi Laura —

Our renewal is coming up (Dec 1). We're interested in expanding our Dedicated commitment to add regional pools in EU and APAC. High level asks: 
- Add an EU pool (provisioned in Frankfurt) and an APAC pool (provisioned in Singapore) with reserved GPUs.
- Target sustained throughput: ~2.5M generated tokens/day across the account, with burst capacity to 5M/day.
- Latency expectation: p95 < 80ms, p99 < 120ms for short sequences (<=512 tokens) in-region; during cross-region failover we'd accept up to 200ms p99.
- Term: open to 12–24 month commitment depending on pricing.

Please find attached a short RFP and traffic projections. Can we schedule a technical + commercial call next week to align on sizing, failover behavior, and SLA language?

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Platform — Nimbus Analytics

Subject: Draft MAP & preliminary commercial (attached)

Sanjay —

Great to connect. Per our intake, attached is a draft mutual action plan and a preliminary commercial for review. High-level proposal:
- Term: 24 months preferred; 12 months available at a 15% uplift.
- Dedicated pools (reserved):
  * EU (Frankfurt): 6 x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs
  * APAC (Singapore): 4 x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs
  * US retained: existing committed pool (no change)
- Throughput & SLA: guaranteed baseline of 2.5M tokens/day sustained. Performance objective: p95 < 100ms, p99 < 150ms in-region for <=1024 tokens. Cross-region failover objective: p99 < 200ms when routing to alternate region; warm-cache failover target p99 < 180ms.
- Failover behavior: automated region routing with a warm-standby cache policy; customer-visible failover dashboard; explicit runbook for long-duration outages.
- Pricing sketch: line items in attached spreadsheet (redwood_dedicated_tiers_v2.xlsx).

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_tiers_v2.xlsx, proposed_multipool_sla_draft.docx

If this direction looks reasonable, we can lock the commercial and put a DocuSign to your contracts team while Eng validates capacity timelines. Laura will coordinate the kickoff.

—Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — good start. A few notes from our side:
- Term: we'd prefer 12 months, but can accept 18 months if you can reduce the 12-month uplift to 10% (we need flexibility for an exec-level procurement review).
- GPU mix: can we consider a spot/ephemeral burst pool in APAC for 2 GPUs to reduce base cost (used for non-latency-critical workloads)?
- Failover SLA: we'll need auditability — continuous audit logs for routing decisions and a runbook within the SLA.
- Quantization option: do you support int8 or 4-bit quantization paths for lower-cost model variants? Would like guidance on expected quality vs cost.

Also looping in our contracts team (contracts@nimbus.ai) — they'll want a marked DocuSign and SOC/audit evidence for data handling.

—Sanjay
